plugins.description: Record product demos in Chrome with Recordful and edit, organise and share them: the recordful MCP server (with the hosted editing tools when signed in), six skills (record-demo, recordful-motion, edit-video, remove-mistakes, make-short, polish-demo) and a /record-demo command.
